semantics: persistent_id is an automatic, unvalidated anonymous grouping of fragments within this one run. It is not a verified real-world player identity, does not change player_id/team_id/person_uid, and is not human-reviewed. persistent_team_status says whether persistent_team_id comes from calibrated team_id, uncalibrated kit-cluster proposals, both (agreeing), or none. No ground truth was used; expect wrong merges between similar kits and new IDs after camera cuts.
